name: sol-advisor
description: Turn Sol-led orchestration on or off for one Codex chat, keep every new chat off by default, route active work to Terra / High or Luna / Max, and report the route.

interface.shortDescription: Turn on Sol-led routing across Terra / High and Luna / Max, with visible route reporting.
interface.longDescription: Activate Sol Advisor once for the current Codex chat in plain language or with the literal skill invocation. Direct ON/OFF markers in that chat preserve state across its later requests, while plugin state, memory, summaries, and every other chat are ignored. GPT-5.6 Sol / High keeps architecture, decomposition, verification, and acceptance, automatically chooses the efficient capable implementation route, announces it before work starts, and reports the actual route in the final output. Native work uses GPT-5.6 Terra / High plus a fresh Sol reviewer; app-task work uses a user-visible GPT-5.6 Luna / Max task through list_projects, list_threads, create_thread, wait_threads, read_thread, and send_message_to_thread.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Sol Advisor on” in this chat when you want Sol-led routing; otherwise it stays off.
